exclusionCheck.method: Each owner/repo (current name from gh api repos/<r>) compared case-insensitively against all repository and family values in campaign/corpus/excluded-families.json, the 90 already-selected repos listed by the coordinator, and the repos in realistic-01..07, messy-01 and messy-02 file names. Project names grepped whole-word (grep -w -i) in docs/testing/repository-compatibility/benchmark.yaml: nightscout, audiobookshelf, glance, InvokeAI, kubero, dnn, dotnetnuke, openpanel, akhq, rancher gave 0 hits each (pterodactyl later removed). Replacement opensearch-dashboards: 1 unrelated hit. Lineage checked from known project history: no candidate is a fork, upstream, rename or successor of an excluded or selected repo. gh api confirmed fork=false and archived=false for all 10. Dropped while selecting: huggingface/text-generation-inference (archived), kubernetes-retired/dashboard (archived), Graylog2/graylog2-server (no usable Dockerfile), jellyfin/jellyfin (no Dockerfile in repo; replaced by audiobookshelf), redpanda-data/console (no Dockerfile, no SPDX license; replaced by akhq). Coordinator review: pterodactyl/panel rejected (MySQL also supported, so MariaDB is not a clear boundary) and replaced by opensearch-project/OpenSearch-Dashboards after the same checks.

boundaryReason.scopeCitation: mvp-scope.md 'Explicit MVP non-goals' (line 173-175): "Databases other than PostgreSQL and RDS MySQL: ... MongoDB"
boundaryReason.repoEvidence: docker-compose.yml:10-14 runs image mongo:5.0.32 with /data/db volume; package.json:137 depends on mongodb ^5.9.2; docker-compose.yml:45 documents MONGO_CONNECTION as the database setting.

candidates.selectionReason: Node CGM monitor whose only datastore is MongoDB; clear MongoDB boundary case with a root Dockerfile.
candidates.lineageCheck: No fork, parent, rename or successor relation to any excluded or selected repository (nightscout is the only project of this name). Project name 'nightscout' not in benchmark.yaml.
candidates.labelingRisk: Medium: analysis may read MONGO_CONNECTION as a plain env var and miss the MongoDB requirement.

boundaryReason.scopeCitation: mvp-scope.md 'Explicit MVP non-goals' (line 173-182): "SQLite" and "Persistent volumes or local disk state"
boundaryReason.repoEvidence: Dockerfile:75-76 sets CONFIG_PATH=/config and METADATA_PATH=/metadata; docker-compose.yml:9-22 mounts ./audiobooks, ./podcasts, ./metadata, ./config as volumes 'needed to keep your library persistent'; package.json:60 depends on sqlite3 ^5.1.7 (only database).

candidates.selectionReason: Node media server with embedded SQLite and library data on mounted volumes; no external database option.
candidates.lineageCheck: No lineage to any excluded or selected repository; Kavita and komga are unrelated media servers. Name not in benchmark.yaml.
candidates.labelingRisk: Low: SQLite and volumes are explicit; port 80 and a health route are likely detected.

boundaryReason.repoEvidence: Dockerfile final lines: ENTRYPOINT ["/app/glance", "--config", "/app/config/glance.yml"] with no config copied into the image; docs/configuration.md documents glance.yml as the only configuration source.

candidates.labelingRisk: Medium: some labelers may treat the missing config as a needs-input item instead of a boundary case; no database or env vars.
